lint.title: RTL Lint
lint.purpose: Check SystemVerilog syntax and selected style/static rules before simulation.
lint.pass_means: Verible accepted the RTL under the configured syntax/lint rules.
lint.does_not_mean: It does not prove functional, timing, or protocol correctness.
questions: Did the RTL change since the last green run?

model.title: Mathematical Reference Model
model.purpose: Exercise the executable arithmetic specification used as the primary scoreboard oracle.
model.pass_means: The model script executed and produced deterministic quotient/remainder/DBZ examples.
model.does_not_mean: A successful model script does not test the RTL.
questions: Do quotient and remainder obey N = Q*D + R?
Is the model independent of RTL implementation details?

hypothesis.title: Property-Based Reference Validation
hypothesis.purpose: Stress the independent Radix-2 algorithmic Python model against mathematical division.
hypothesis.pass_means: Hypothesis found no generated counterexample for the configured campaign.
hypothesis.does_not_mean: This does not involve the RTL, so it cannot prove the DUT is correct.
questions: Are widths and boundary relations represented?

sim.title: RTL Simulation
sim.purpose: Execute the cocotb dynamic verification suite against the current Verilator executable.
sim.pass_means: All executed dynamic test cases passed their scoreboard/protocol checks.
sim.does_not_mean: Simulation is not exhaustive; a reused sim_build can also be stale after branch changes.

sim_fresh.title: Fresh RTL Simulation
sim_fresh.purpose: Rebuild the current RTL with Verilator and execute the cocotb test plan without stale branch artifacts.
sim_fresh.pass_means: All executed RTL test cases passed their scoreboard/protocol checks.
sim_fresh.does_not_mean: Simulation is not exhaustive; passing random tests does not prove all inputs/states.
questions: Did exact latency and done pulse pass?

formal.title: Bounded Formal Verification
formal.purpose: Use SymbiYosys/Yosys/Z3 to search symbolically for bounded counterexamples to arithmetic/control properties.
formal.pass_means: No counterexample was found within the configured formal depth for the active assertions.
formal.does_not_mean: BMC PASS is not an unbounded proof. Missing properties cannot be proven.
questions: Did any mutation survive because a property was missing?

cover.title: Formal Cover / Reachability
cover.purpose: Demonstrate that important completion scenarios are actually reachable under the formal harness.
cover.pass_means: The solver found witnesses for configured cover statements.
cover.does_not_mean: Cover PASS says a scenario is reachable; it does not say that scenario is correct.
questions: Are assertions evaluated on reachable completions?

synth.title: Generic Yosys Synthesis
synth.purpose: Convert RTL into a technology-independent logic network and record structural complexity.
synth.pass_means: Yosys elaborated and synthesized the RTL without fatal errors.
synth.does_not_mean: Generic cell counts are not SKY130 physical area and cannot be compared directly to final PnR instance counts.

asic.title: SKY130 RTL-to-GDS Physical Design
asic.purpose: Technology-map, place, clock, route, extract and sign off the divider using LibreLane/OpenROAD and SKY130.
asic.pass_means: The flow completed; final DRC/LVS/Antenna and timing evidence can be inspected.
asic.does_not_mean: Closing a 20 ns target does not mean Fmax=50 MHz. Power is not final until activity/constraints are controlled.
